scope: Targeted primary-source research for the advisor protocol, not an exhaustive review of leading papers.

records.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
records.authors: Jeremy Hadfield, Barry Zhang, Kenneth Lien, Florian Scholz, Jeremy Fox, Daniel Ford / Anthropic
records.reading_depth: Selected substantive sections: architecture, benefit/cost discussion, coordination limitations, persistent artifact handoff.
records.used_for: Parallelize separable research; avoid assuming tightly coupled coding benefits from a larger swarm.
records.limitations: Internal evaluation and developer account; no reproduction here.

records.title: Demystifying evals for AI agents
records.reading_depth: Evaluation definitions, grader types, reliability metrics and roadmap sections.
records.used_for: Separate claimed success from achieved state; deterministic checks and model judgments have different scopes.
records.limitations: Engineering guidance rather than validation of the physics model.

records.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
records.authors: Prithvi Rajasekaran, Ethan Dixon, Carly Ryan, Jeremy Hadfield / Anthropic
records.reading_depth: Substantive article text including retrieval, compaction, notes and subagent architecture.
records.used_for: Use compact contracts with artifact pointers and retrieve relevant evidence at the point of use.
records.limitations: No measurement of the current project or installed memory system.

records.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
records.reading_depth: Selected full-text sections 2.3–2.6, 3.1–3.2, 4, 7, Appendix A and judge details; submission history checked.
records.used_for: Code, execution and result matching must be separately graded; judge error and contamination remain.
records.limitations: ML replication benchmark; automated judge is not a physics correctness oracle.

records.title: PaperBench repository
records.reading_depth: Repository page and exposed README/setup content; original preparedness URL redirects to frontier-evals.
records.used_for: Reuse hierarchical rubric/reproduction-artifact design where useful.
records.limitations: Not cloned, installed or executed in this process review; no commit pinned.

records.title: Evaluating AI's ability to perform scientific research tasks
records.reading_depth: Benchmark construction, grading, model-performance and limitations sections.
records.used_for: Expert-written constrained subtasks do not measure all activities required for scientific discovery.
records.limitations: Vendor benchmark; current model capability cannot be inferred from the older reported model ranking.

records.title: Our First Proof submissions
records.reading_depth: Announcement and explicit correction of initial confidence in problem 2.
records.used_for: Preserve failed/retracted interpretations and separate proof attempt from accepted proof.
records.limitations: Individual proof manuscripts were not independently verified here.

records.title: Recent Frontier Models Are Reward Hacking
records.authors: Sydney Von Arx, Lawrence Chan, Beth Barnes / METR
records.reading_depth: Introduction and concrete scorer/reference/timing manipulation examples.
records.used_for: Candidate/evaluator separation, source hashes and checks on actual outcomes.
records.limitations: No replication of METR tasks; examples motivate protocol controls.

records.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
records.authors: Juraj Gottweis, Wei-Hung Weng, Alexander Daryin et al.
records.reading_depth: Architecture/methods, Elo evaluation, human-evaluation caveats, experimental-validation overview, ablation and limitations sections; publication and version-of-record dates checked.
records.used_for: Use proposal-generation/reflection loops but do not treat auto-evaluation as independent ground truth.
records.limitations: Mostly biomedical validation; experiments and supplementary prompts not reproduced here. Version of record 2026-07-01.

records.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
records.reading_depth: Problem, result, agent-method and artifact-link sections.
records.used_for: Separate mathematical variants, stage easier subproblems, and preserve independently checkable proof artifacts.
records.limitations: Very recent developer announcement; acceptance and complete proof validity not adjudicated by this project.

records.title: Finite time blowup for Navier–Stokes
records.reading_depth: Abstract, table of contents and Theorem 1.1 on opening page of 166-page manuscript.
records.used_for: The announced theorem includes smooth compactly supported forcing; do not describe it as the unforced Navier–Stokes problem.
records.limitations: No complete proof review, Lean compilation or independent certificate audit; announcement association 2026-09-08.

records.title: NavierStokesAndEuler
records.reading_depth: Repository listing and README theorem scope.
records.used_for: A linked formalization is an inspectable artifact, not an automatically reproduced verification.
records.limitations: Not cloned or built; no assumptions audit or commit pin performed.

records.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems
records.reading_depth: Introduction and coordination comparison including search-scope/token confounding and dependent-work caveat.
records.used_for: Compare swarms on matched scope and resources; explicit roles and ownership for coupled work.
records.limitations: Developer experiments in software tasks; no direct estimate of science performance.

access_gaps.result: Web open returned internal error; not used for a new factual claim. Prior project FunSearch review remains separate.

local_review.report_reading_depth: Relevant model, four-front map, result/next-step sections and archived metadata; this pass does not claim full reproduction of all 81 prior sources.
local_review.new_source_mismatch: Delivered j0 sums Jrz and Jkin separately; prior narrative described per-mode cancellation. Algebraic equivalence does not guarantee identical floating-point stability.
